basis: Sterol biosynthesis defect with autoinflammatory periodic fever; persistent neurologic damage chiefly affects the severe mevalonic aciduria subtype.

Connective soft tissue neoplasm with fibromyxoid stroma; no additional organ involvement is established.
Intestinal protozoal infection; no common direct extraintestinal organ damage is established.
Cardiac and aortic abnormalities anchor this spectrum; skin, limb and brain abnormalities vary by phenotype and are not established in most patients across the umbrella.
Defined by inherited progressive degeneration and atrophy of the nervous system; other organ involvement is subtype dependent.
Inflammation of the inner ear; infection or immune mediation is not established for every form of this etiologically mixed umbrella.
Creatine biosynthesis disorder; cerebral creatine deficiency causes developmental and cognitive impairment in most patients with AGAT or GAMT deficiency.
Congenital duplication of the preaxial skeletal elements of the foot; nonsyndromic.
Bacterial infection; focal osteoarticular infection occurs in roughly 30-50%, varying by series. Limb or back pain alone does not establish involvement.
Goniodysgenesis and intellectual disability define ocular and neurologic abnormalities; short stature alone does not establish locomotor tissue damage.
HSV-2 infection produces genital mucocutaneous lesions; neuronal latency alone does not establish neurologic damage.
Distal skeletal muscle dystrophy with tibialis anterior weakness and atrophy in 71/71 patients; no common additional organ damage is established.
Arthritis affects the sacroiliac joints; the sparse hereditary record does not establish a specific infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.
Loss of elastic fibers in the mid dermis causes persistent skin wrinkling and laxity; no established common systemic involvement.
MIB1-related left ventricular noncompaction is a structural myocardial disorder; additional organ damage is not established.
Neoplasm located in the cornea; no additional organ involvement is intrinsic to this umbrella.
Malignant retinal tumor; secondary nonocular cancers are separate diseases, and intracranial tumors or extension affect a minority.
Autonomic bladder dysfunction defines the disorder. Pupillary slowing in 4/5 reflects autonomic dysfunction without documented eye damage; urinary tract findings share the renal axis.
Mitochondrial ATP synthase deficiency; encephalopathy, ataxia or neuropathy affect most mitochondrial type 1 presentations. Retinal and muscle damage vary by phenotype.
Pituitary growth hormone deficiency causes proportionate growth failure; short stature alone does not establish musculoskeletal damage.
Inherited neurodegeneration with obligate dementia and common motor deterioration; stiffness and gait abnormalities reflect neurologic disease.
Clonal myeloid proliferation involving blood and marrow; thrombosis and other extrahematologic complications are not defining or established as common.
Inherited distal axonal sensory neuropathy; frequencies do not establish additional qualifying organ damage. Osteomyelitis is a secondary infection.
Inherited marrow precursor deficiency causing anemia with possible additional cytopenias; extrahematologic abnormalities vary among subtypes.
